'''Aquala''', also called "'''finned Aqualish'''," were an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. Aquala had finned hands and two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] like the [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] subspecies.
